verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of business. Its legaltech offerings are questionnaire-driven document generators (Contract Express) and partner tools (Legora, Luminance, HighQ), not developer APIs. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI paths all returned 404, so nothing shows the firm actually ships an API reference that would make the axis apply.
